name: How do I choose a kitchen faucet that actually fits my sink?
description: Measure the sink first, then match the faucet to the number of holes, spout height, and reach so the setup fits and functions well.

mainEntity.name: How do I choose a kitchen faucet that actually fits my sink?

acceptedAnswer.text: Start with the **sink size and hole pattern**, then choose a faucet with the right spout height, reach, and mounting style. The goal is a faucet that fits the sink physically and still looks balanced in the room.
